prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header only lists application/json (previously required both application/json AND text/event-stream) — both PRs relax the same 406 check in webStandardStreamableHttp.ts's Accept header validation. prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that splits the Accept header per RFC 7231 semantics: it trims/lowercases each media-range, strips parameters, and explicitly excludes entries with q=0 (client-rejected types) and handles wildcard type/subtype matching. 2046's inline fix uses acceptHeader?.includes('application/json'), a plain substring check that would false-positive on any media type containing that substring (e.g. 'application/json-patch+json') and does not honor q=0 rejection or wildcards. 1996 is the more complete fix for the same header-parsing gap.
